items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 12 August 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Variable, becoming south or southwest overnight, 2 to 4. Occasionally Variable 3 or less in places at times.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then risk of mist and fog patches tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, veering west or northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Friday, occasionally 5 in places.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Risk of mist and fog patches patches at first, and rain for a time, then becoming on Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Possibly poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches at first, and moderate in rain, otherwise good.
